build_multi_task_metric: build a MultiTasksMetric instance with task_metrics dict mapping task names to metric configs
process_data_samples: process a batch of data samples through MultiTasksMetric for each registered task
evaluate_model_performance: evaluate model performance across all tasks and return aggregated metrics dictionary
register_metric_module: register MultiTasksMetric in the METRICS registry for use in mmpretrain evaluation pipelines
filter_eval_samples: filter data samples by eval_mask before processing metrics for each task
